verdict.rationale: A robotics simulation platform could plausibly offer in-product AI analysis of simulation or sensor data, so the axis applies, but no evidence shows one. The AI-related items are adjacent features that don't qualify: agent skills for coding agents (installation, environment creation, ROS node upgrades), AI models such as GR00T, and RL training frameworks. None of these surface AI-generated insights or suggestions from the user's own data inside the product.
